scope.order: Alternating arm order by sample; ready sessions reused across tasks.
scope.timed_boundary: Existing scrape task call through returned result. Service/browser startup, warmup and cleanup are outside the timer.
scope.metric: Task wall time in milliseconds. Native memory and CPU remain unmeasured.
scope.interface: OpenBrowser namespace scrape_page with automatic HTTP/browser selection, and official Playwright MCP/CLI scripted browser programs.
scope.oracle: Complete ordered Item/Value fields, 30 SKU ids, 100 pagination ids, all 40 table rows with six cells, and 20 ordered headlines.
scope.mechanism: OpenBrowser uses HTTP on static article, pagination and table; it uses the browser on JS list and asset-heavy pages. Playwright uses Chrome on every task.
scope.output: Required fixture data are checked. Markdown/plain-text serialization differs for static articles.
scope.cleanup: All five harness cleanup calls succeeded. An independent readable-process scan found no Playwright temporary-scope process. Denied host reads and absent OpenBrowser PID census limit independent cleanup coverage.
scope.path_redaction: The public environment uses $CHROME_BIN for the machine-specific executable path; all measured sample fields are unchanged.
scope.package_version: The environment OpenBrowser version is installed distribution metadata; source_commit and app_digest identify the package source executed through PYTHONPATH.

host.background: An existing OpenBrowser daemon and background communication/security applications were present in both host snapshots. The run uses interleaved samples under this shared load.
host.independent_after_run_daemon_probe: An unchanged PID/create-time daemon used 0.370802688 CPU seconds in a one-second read-only probe after the run. Its exact CPU usage during measured samples was not recorded. No signal was sent.
